notes: Every .docx under tests/fixtures/ has an entry naming its producer, version, how it was produced and what it exercises. Only self-authored or generated content is admitted; authors inside fixtures are fictional.

pandoc fixtures are regenerated from tests/fixtures/sources by oracle/make_fixtures.py and checked byte-for-byte in CI. LibreOffice fixtures are the pandoc fixtures round-tripped by `make_fixtures.py --libreoffice` on the version recorded, and are committed because LibreOffice output depends on its version.

Word fixtures are seed packages written by oracle/make_word_fixtures.py with fictional authors, opened and saved as Word documents by Microsoft Word on macOS, with Word's last-editor property replaced by the seed's fictional editor; Word output is not reproducible, so they are committed bytes and not regenerated by the check.

pandoc/basics.docx.purpose: headings, inline formatting (bold, italic, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, code), hyperlink, block quote, horizontal rule, title and author metadata

pandoc/lists.docx.purpose: numbered and bulleted lists, nesting, mixed list kinds

pandoc/tables.docx.purpose: tables with header rows, column alignment, a single-cell table, paragraphs between tables

pandoc/comments.docx.purpose: three comments by two authors with dates, anchored to a whole paragraph, a phrase and a sentence; comments.xml without the Microsoft extension parts

pandoc/revisions.docx.purpose: tracked insertions and deletions by two authors inside paragraphs and as whole paragraphs

pandoc/review.docx.purpose: comments and tracked changes together, a comment spanning a revision, a table, list items inserted and deleted

libreoffice/basics.docx.purpose: LibreOffice's serialization of the same content: mc:Ignorable declarations, its style set and settings

libreoffice/lists.docx.purpose: LibreOffice numbering definitions and list paragraphs

libreoffice/tables.docx.purpose: LibreOffice table grid, widths and cell properties

libreoffice/comments.docx.purpose: LibreOffice comment serialization, including the extension parts it writes

libreoffice/revisions.docx.purpose: LibreOffice tracked-change serialization and revision identifiers

libreoffice/review.docx.purpose: comments and tracked changes together as LibreOffice writes them

word/comments.docx.source: oracle/make_word_fixtures.py: seed `comments` opened and saved with `save as ... file format format document`; cp:lastModifiedBy replaced by the seed's fictional editor
word/comments.docx.purpose: Word comment threads: a comment with two replies, a resolved comment with a reply (w15:done), a comment authored without a range (Word writes it as an empty range), a comment over two paragraphs with two paragraphs of text; comments.xml with commentsExtended, commentsIds, commentsExtensible and people parts; three fictional authors

word/revisions.docx.source: oracle/make_word_fixtures.py: seed `revisions` opened and saved with `save as ... file format format document`; cp:lastModifiedBy replaced by the seed's fictional editor
word/revisions.docx.purpose: every revision kind Word 16.114 keeps from a seed: run insertion and deletion, a move (moveFrom/moveTo with range markers), paragraph-mark insertion and deletion, run and paragraph property changes, a section property change, a deleted field with its instruction, table row insertion and deletion, row and cell property changes, cell insertion, deletion and vertical-merge revisions (for which Word writes its own table-exception and grid changes), tracking switched on in settings; Word drops a seeded table property change (tblPrChange), so none is present

word/tables.docx.source: oracle/make_word_fixtures.py: seed `tables` opened and saved with `save as ... file format format document`; cp:lastModifiedBy replaced by the seed's fictional editor
word/tables.docx.purpose: a Word table with a repeated header row, shading, a vertical merge, a horizontal span and a nested table

word/report.docx.source: oracle/make_word_fixtures.py: seed `report` opened and saved with `save as ... file format format document`; cp:lastModifiedBy replaced by the seed's fictional editor
word/report.docx.purpose: Word headers and footers with PAGE and NUMPAGES fields over two sections (portrait and landscape), a footnote and an endnote, an external and an internal hyperlink, a bookmark, bulleted and numbered lists with two levels, and an inline PNG image the script generates
